summary: StudentExpenseHistory is a user control in the HSPnet system that displays a student's expense history. It retrieves and binds expense history data for a given student, allows printing, and uses a repeater control to render the records.
purpose: To provide a user interface component that displays and manages a student's expense receipt history, including viewing and printing functionalities.

fields.name: updPnlMain
fields.description: Main update panel for asynchronous updates.

fields.name: cmdPrint
fields.description: Button control for printing the expense history.

fields.name: rprHistory
fields.description: Repeater control to display a list of expense history items.

fields.name: dsHistory
fields.description: Data source for retrieving expense history records.

fields.name: StudentID
fields.description: Represents the unique identifier for a student.

workflows.name: Load and Display Student Expense History
steps: dsHistory_Selecting event occurs: checks UserSession. If session is missing, cancels data retrieval; otherwise, sets session and StudentID parameters.
For each history item, rprHistory_ItemDataBound applies alternating row styles.
User can trigger cmdPrint for printing.

business_rules: Data retrieval for expense history is cancelled if UserSession is null.
Styling for rows alternates based on item type.
validations: UserSession presence is validated before data is retrieved.
conditions: Only proceed with expense history retrieval if UserSession is not null.
Apply alternating styles based on ListItemType.
system_behavior: Binds data to the repeater and displays expense history records.
Allows printing of the displayed records.
Automatically applies row styling for visual distinction.
exceptions: If UserSession is null, data retrieval is cancelled and nothing is displayed.
